title: Synthetic Ascension domestic interiors v1
status: Both original source props provisionally kept by lead for native fitting; no native fit, final aesthetic, collision, cover or placement approval.
scope: Exactly two small household props, one built-in imagegen generation call each. No furnishing catalogue, variants or edits.

coordinate_convention.anchor_note: A placement datum may be in transparent space, as for the cot's midpoint between feet. Support points are also supplied.
coordinate_convention.alpha_note: Threshold bounds are measurements only. Raw alpha>0 includes residue; do not infer tight crop, collision or physical footprint from it.

references.role: Accepted temperate European painterly materials/daylight, simplify detail.
Actual empty clay-domestic cutaway camera, actor and room scale; prior controlled native sample, not a current runtime acceptance.
Current source-backed household brief; bed/cooking purpose cues, preserve real wall/roof/entry geometry.

assets.processing: Original PNG copied unchanged; no resize, trim, alpha cleanup, repaint, compositing or re-encoding.
assets.status: Lead KEEP provisionally for native fitting. Alpha must stay intact. Not natively approved; no extra furniture generated.
assets.ownership: Interior ground prop fitted to a real dwelling and its room/roof ownership. Production owns room attachment, sorting, cutaway visibility, cover/collision and clear routes.
assets.measurement_method: Dimensions, alpha and pixel values read from actual original PNG using Pillow; placement anchors/ground footprints manually selected from viewed image. Footprint is approximate where height occludes the rear contact plane.
assets.anchor_definition: Midpoint datum on the two visible south/front foot-contact baseline, intentionally in transparent space between feet. Not the blanket center and not a painted support pixel.
assets.orientation: Head/pillow at north/top; long axis north-south, exactly image vertical. Warm upper-right light.

runtime_sizing.note: Start near60px width for about107px estimated ground length. At75px width the unchanged source is about134px estimated ground length, outside the brief's length range. Fit using uniform scale, never stretch; source projection/feet must be checked in actual room.

visual_findings.blanket: Muted grey-sage wool with worn cream linen.
visual_findings.projection: Strong top-facing mattress with north-south alignment and shallow frame planes. Narrow adult cot silhouette, more front board than pure plan view.
visual_findings.preview_note: RGB channels contain a broad brown surround, but checked surround samples have alpha0 and alpha>=8 bounds hug the bed. Preserve RGBA; an RGB-only or alpha-ignoring preview can show the hidden surround. Faint low-alpha residue remains.
visual_findings.limits: Dense woven source texture may merge at runtime; rear foot contact is occluded by the frame. Actual human/room scale, visible solid furniture and collider/cover contract remain untested.

assets.anchor_definition: South/front center contact datum just inside the low stone base edge; not pot center or image center.
assets.orientation: Back toward north/top and a future real wall; pot/recess faces south. Main assembly long axis east-west.

runtime_sizing.note: Source is shallower than the brief's50–75px ground-depth guide. At120px width total visible height is about52.75 and estimated ground depth about45.38. Preserve source aspect; production fits real ground/placement rather than stretching to a placeholder rectangle. Rear footprint y is approximate under raised stones.

visual_findings.projection: Top stone surfaces and pot opening dominate; shallow front base. Coherent low horizontal hearth with side wood nook.
visual_findings.limits: Low-alpha residue and tiny colored edge fringes remain. Source stones/ash are detailed and may merge at native size. Apparent base depth is not calibrated gameplay geometry; real wall fit and room occlusion untested.

authority.production_owns: All integration, engine/import/test/capture, product code, cover/collision/placement and Git.

verification.method: Read-only Pillow inspection plus SHA256 and byte comparison. No image compositing or native scene rendering.
verification.limits: Source visual review and estimated contact/footprint measurements only; not native camera/actor fit or final aesthetics.
